description: Frozen four-case live-model research quality pilot (08-LIVE-MODEL-QUALITY-PILOT-PLAN.md §4).

cases.label: NZ retailer product identity and price state
cases.objective: Identify the exact GIB Aqualine 10 x 2400 x 1200 mm plasterboard sheet sold by a current New Zealand retailer, and report its current public retail price from the retailer page you retain. Report an amount only if the retained page actually contains one; otherwise state that the price is unavailable from the retained page.
constraints: Use a current New Zealand retailer page as the source for price and availability.
Search result snippets are discovery hints only and are never price evidence.
Retain the product identity — name, size and any product code — from the page you cite.
Never infer, convert, estimate or substitute a price, and never report a missing price as zero.
State the time at which you retrieved any price, because it is a dynamic fact.

forbiddenInferences: reporting a price that is absent from the retained page
reporting an absent price as 0, $0, free or nil
citing a search snippet as price evidence
converting or estimating an amount from another market
oracle.reviewNotes: A correct answer either quotes an amount present in the retained retailer page, or says the amount is unavailable from that page.

cases.label: AU native PDF table with physical page grounding
cases.capability: Native PDF, table reading and page grounding
cases.objective: Using the James Hardie Hardie Weather Barrier installation guide for Australia, report the direct-fixed summer and winter total R-values stated for R2.0.
constraints: Use the manufacturer's own published installation guide as the source.
Cite the exact retained physical page for every value you report.
Do not combine values taken from different pages, and do not quote aggregate text in place of the table row.
If the retained pages do not contain the value, say so rather than approximating it.

forbiddenInferences: quoting the value from a page other than retained physical page 2
quoting an aggregate summary in place of the R2.0 table row
reporting a rounded or derived R-value
oracle.reviewNotes: Both values must be supported by retained physical page 2 of the captured PDF.

cases.label: AU scanned heritage assessment and honest unresolved evidence
cases.capability: Difficult OCR and honest unresolved evidence
cases.objective: For the City of Vincent heritage assessment of 126 Buxton Street, establish (a) whether the assessment refers to building licence plans dated March 1951, and (b) whether retained physical page 19 of that document supports the exact wording "Plan of Garage".
constraints: Use the council's own published assessment document.
Answer (b) only from retained physical page 19; finding the phrase anywhere else does not answer it.
If the retained page-19 text does not contain the exact wording, report (b) as unresolved rather than resolving it.
Do not treat absence from an OCR capture as proof of absence from the original document.

forbiddenInferences: answering the page-19 question from a different page
answering the page-19 question from a search snippet or document index
asserting the phrase is absent from the original document rather than from the retained page
oracle.reviewNotes: The 1951 reference should be supported; the page-19 wording must be reported unresolved when the exact text is absent from the retained page.

cases.label: AU manufacturer specification plus retailer price state
cases.objective: Verify the exact James Hardie Villaboard lining 2400 x 1200 x 6 mm product from a manufacturer source, then report its current Australian retailer price, or explicit unavailability, from a retailer source.
constraints: Use a manufacturer source for product specification and a retailer source for current price or availability.
Attribute every claim to the source class it came from; do not cite a retailer page for a manufacturer specification.
Search result snippets are discovery hints only and are never price evidence.
Never infer, convert or estimate a price, and never report a missing price as zero.
State the time at which you retrieved any price, because it is a dynamic fact.

forbiddenInferences: citing a retailer page as evidence for a manufacturer specification
citing a manufacturer page as evidence for a current retail price
reporting an absent price as 0, $0, free or nil
merging manufacturer and retailer claims into one unattributed statement
oracle.reviewNotes: Specification and price claims must remain attributed to their own source class.
